_what: Law 2 (2026-11-25): GitHub Actions runs cited as evidence that were already RED when scripts/resolve_evidence_runs.py was written. Each entry is a capability marked verified on a run that failed. Listing an id does not pass it: the check prints one ::warning per id saying so and a step-summary section. The list only shrinks: the check fails when a listed id is green, no longer cited, or cited in other files than cited_in says, and when a red id is not listed. An entry needs a reason and a reviewer who is not its author, checked like a deletion (scripts/deletions_declared.py). To clear an entry: re-run the workflow green, cite the new run, and remove the entry; or mark the capability unverified and remove the citation.
